_doc: HW1 sound and music -> AE. 'sounds': a PlaySound node's bank file:name -> the FMOD event AE's own levels use for the same moment. 'music' / 'ambience': a PlayMusic track (sound/music.xml:<name>) -> the MusicMode / AmbienceMode value AE's region table (tweak/regions.sval) gives the matching Castle Hammerwatch area; the acts are prison, armory, archives, chambers. 'music_stingers': tracks AE plays as a one-shot event. Anything missing here stays a plain ScriptLink and is reported.
